parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: The MySQL database schema to connect to.

parameters.name: log_sql
parameters.description: Whether to log SQL query when it's executed. Defaults to *True*.

parameters.name: s3_source_key
parameters.description: The path to the file (S3 key) that will be loaded into MySQL.

parameters.name: mysql_table
parameters.description: The MySQL table into where the data will be sent.

parameters.name: mysql_duplicate_key_handling
parameters.description: Specify what should happen to duplicate data. You can choose either `IGNORE` or `REPLACE`.

parameters.name: mysql_extra_options
parameters.description: MySQL options to specify exactly how to load the data.

parameters.name: aws_conn_id
parameters.description: The S3 connection that contains the credentials to the S3 Bucket.

parameters.name: mysql_local_infile
parameters.description: flag to enable local_infile option on the MySQLHook. This loads MySQL directly using the LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE command. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: sql
parameters.description: SQL query to execute against Presto. (templated)

parameters.name: mysql_table
parameters.description: target MySQL table, use dot notation to target a specific database. (templated)

parameters.name: mysql_preoperator
parameters.description: sql statement to run against mysql prior to import, typically use to truncate of delete in place of the data coming in, allowing the task to be idempotent (running the task twice won't double load data). (templated)
